card.name: Relative words after device or drug nouns
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "that", "those" or "than" right after a noun for a device or drug class, where a description of how it works follows (e.g. monitors that use test strips).

modes.label: Relative word after device
modes.description: "that" or "those" introduces a description of the testing system or drug class by how it works.
modes.example: can interfere with the readings of blood glucose monitors<< that>> use test strips with glucose dehydrogen

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like "drugs", "its" or "than" that lead into a mechanism or comparison.
modes.example: Based on<< its>> mechanism of action and findings in animal studies

card.writes: It pushes toward words like "powered", "mechanism" and "wind", which describe how a device or drug works.
card.plain: It marks a small linking word after a device or drug name, just before a description of how it works.
